profile.headline: Systems Administrator at Red Hat
profile.summary:
The many paths I've traveled leaves me with a unique experience and perspective in every aspect I do.  Whether it has been through a career path or a personal hobby, I strive for a complete understanding in not only what I do but also what supports what I do.  

My career path focuses on varies implementations of hardware and virtualization compute infrastructure and the better management systems.  I've also a strong interest and some focus in various parts of radio, common hardware platforms, storage, and networking.

In my free time, I tend to spend my time developing new ways of doing common things, I spend a lot of time figure skating, ballet, working on cars, some photography, music.  I do spend a small amount of time developing tools in or with software that intersects with some of the passions that drive me.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered for EMT-Basic services with Stoney Point Fire Department for night crews.
